body.message: La llave de idempotencia ya está siendo utilizada por otra solicitud.

note: Authored. idempotency_key_in_use is a documented RequestErrorCode ('The idempotency key is already being used by another request'); its HTTP status is NOT documented for POST /invoices, so 409 (the documented Conflict response) is an assumption. cfdi classifies by code, never by this status.
